title: Make the night feel alive
summary: Unifies the core Night, Changes and Breaks experience around clearer hierarchy, semantic colour, current-night context, calmer completed states and more convincing Liquid Glass chrome, without adding a countdown timer.
changes: Night now shows a live duty-state cue, a non-countdown 00:00–07:00 orientation rail, an at-a-glance strip for current state, personal break and unread Chat, a calmer seven-nurse information treatment, smarter since-last-open activity summaries and Jump to me navigation.

Changes now treats an already published plan as a calm completed state with a compact Shared workflow and a quieter View or adjust roles action, while healthy realtime copy is reduced to Up to date and genuine unresolved work still restores the stronger action state.

Breaks now reads as one grouped schedule with Jump to me and structured Labour Ward, Pager and seventh-nurse coverage rows, while shared typography, semantic colours, reduced card furniture, stronger content-under-glass chrome, subtle haptics and accessibility fallbacks are applied across the core app.
